comment: The GTE: each command (sf/lm, MVMVA's mx/v/cv) on random and edge register sets, run by MIPS routines in scratch RAM that load all 64 registers, issue the command and store them back; RTPS division sweeps; LIBGTE's rsin/rcos, RotMatrixYXZ_gte/ZYX_gte, ScaleMatrix, ApplyMatrixSV.

oracle.method: lua-calls: tests/golden/oracle.lua hijacks the game at pad_update (-debugger -interpreter)
oracle.resident: CNTY_SEL loaded; the GTE routines are this family's own code in scratch RAM
